_note: Scripted Risk flags for vendor-agreement-02, modelled on First American (three-year term, $495 exit fee). Every Default Red line is seeded. Several Red line matches are scripted below Don't sign as written on purpose: Review must raise each to Don't sign as written. Red lines 2 and 4 cite two sentences each. The late fee matches no Red line and keeps its scripted Severity.

riskFlags.title: Three-year initial term
riskFlags.says: The agreement runs for three years from the date Bluebird Bakery signs it.
sourceSentences: This Agreement runs for an initial term of three years from the date Merchant signs it.
riskFlags.counterOffer: This Agreement runs for an initial term of one year from the date Merchant signs it.

riskFlags.title: Automatic renewal, and $495 to leave early
riskFlags.says: The agreement renews by itself for a year at a time unless Bluebird Bakery gives written notice at least ninety days before the renewal date. Ending it before a term is over costs $495.
sourceSentences: At the end of each term, this Agreement renews automatically for a further one-year term unless Merchant gives written notice at least ninety days before the renewal date.
If Merchant ends this Agreement before the end of a term for any reason, Merchant will pay Processor an early termination fee of $495.
riskFlags.counterOffer: At the end of each term, this Agreement renews for a further one-year term only if Merchant gives written notice before the renewal date. Merchant will pay no early termination fee if it ends this Agreement at the end of a term.

riskFlags.title: Processor can change fees by email
riskFlags.says: Harbor Point can change any fee or add a new one at any time by sending an email.
sourceSentences: Processor can change any fee, or add a new fee, at any time by sending Merchant an email.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Processor will not change any fee, or add a new fee, unless Merchant agrees in writing.

riskFlags.title: Owner's personal guarantee
riskFlags.says: Henry Alvarez personally guarantees every obligation Bluebird Bakery has under the agreement.
sourceSentences: Henry Alvarez, who owns Merchant, personally guarantees every obligation of Merchant under this Agreement.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Henry Alvarez does not guarantee any obligation of Merchant under this Agreement.

riskFlags.title: Indemnity for all transaction losses
riskFlags.says: Bluebird Bakery covers Harbor Point for all losses, chargebacks and costs from its card transactions, direct and indirect, and this continues after the agreement ends.
riskFlags.judgment: No cap appears in the document.
sourceSentences: Merchant will indemnify Processor against all losses, chargebacks and costs arising from Merchant's card transactions.
This indemnity covers direct and indirect losses and continues after this Agreement ends.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Merchant will indemnify Processor against direct losses, chargebacks and costs arising from Merchant's card transactions. This indemnity does not cover indirect losses and ends when this Agreement ends.

riskFlags.title: $25 late fee
riskFlags.says: Any amount not paid within ten days of its due date carries a $25 late fee.
sourceSentences: Merchant will pay a late fee of $25 for any amount not paid within ten days of its due date.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Merchant will pay a late fee of $25 for any amount not paid within ten days of written notice that it is due.
